packageRules.description: ML stack upgrades are gated on the ComfyUI compatibility matrix and handled deliberately via the engine component channel

gitleaks tags its releases with a v prefix that secret-scan.yml's pin and its download URL both spell bare, so strip it or the bump writes a version no release has. Its own group because GITLEAKS_SHA256 is a second constant no manager moves: a bump carrying a stale checksum must fail on its own branch rather than block every other minor and patch update

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
